query: What are the requirements for refund approval and are shipping fees refunded if I return due to personal preference?
full_draft_text: Refund requests are processed once an order is successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or after the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. All refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel, as AI is prohibited from autonomously approving monetary transactions. If your return is due to personal preference, original shipping fees are non-refundable.

POL-ORD-002:1.0.title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
POL-ORD-002:1.0.content: Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier. POL-RET-003:2.0.content: Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

query: How many business days does it take to receive a refund back to my linked e-wallet or bank card?
full_draft_text: For linked e-wallets (such as MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay, and Viettel Money), funds are returned to the wallet within 1-2 business days. POL-PAY-001:1.0.title: Handling Payment Incidents and Banking Transactions on Tiki
POL-PAY-001:1.0.content: If a customer's bank account or e-wallet is debited but the order on Tiki remains in 'Awaiting Payment' status or fails to display, this is typically due to transmission latency from the payment gateway. The Tiki system and payment gateway automatically reconcile and update the order within 15-30 minutes.
